Title: Project Manager
Job ID: 6364
Location:
Istanbul, TR, 34870
We are looking for a Project Management Professional (f/m/d) to join our team at Innomotics.
The Industry-Leader of Motors and Drives
Innomotics is an industry-leading supplier of motors and large drive systems. With a trusted legacy of more than 150 years of engineering expertise, our products power all of the world’s most essential industries. Today, we are bringing the #EnergyTransition to life with a portfolio that enables our customers to boost energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gases, and minimize the carbon footprints of plants.
Our Most Powerful Engine: Our People
We are a team of more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, innovators. For us, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion. As a global player operating with the spirit and speed of a mid-sized champion, the future holds unlimited opportunities for us. If you share our bold mindset to be best-in-class, we want you IN.
Your Future Role
Responsibilities
As a
Project Manager
responsible for the Project Management activities within
Systems and Solutions Division Türkiye
, you will leverage your high‑level expertise in automation, electrification and digitalization solutions for heavy industries. In this role, you will:
Manage assigned projects end-to-end in line with PM@Innomotics standards.
Plan, execute, and monitor projects including scope, schedule, budget, and resources.
Ensure compliance with quality standards, EHS requirements, and regulatory guidelines.
Take full ownership of project financial performance and overall business success.
Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks while ensuring timely decision-making and escalation when required.
Lead cross-functional project teams and coordinate internal and external stakeholders effectively.
Act as the primary point of contact for customers, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.
Oversee onsite commissioning activities in line with project plans.
Analyze customer requirements and develop optimal technical and commercial solutions.
Capture lessons learned and continuously improve project execution processes.
Support sales and account management teams with technical consulting during customer engagements.
Coordinate agreed commissioning measures onsite.
Demonstrated expertise in defining and tracking project scope, goals, schedule, budgets, and execution strategies in collaboration with project stakeholders (incl. cross-functional teams).
Experience developing and executing Risk Management and Project Communication strategies.
Project NCC Responsibility and control.
Your profile.
Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Electrical-Electronics Engineering. (MBA is an advantage)
Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Project Manager with full responsibility in industrial such as Minerals, Cement, Mining, Oil & Gas, Petrochemical, Power, Water, Metals, Infrastructure projects
Working knowledge of instrumentation, process automation systems, MV & LV electrical switchgear systems, transformers, diesel generators, UPS & installations
Strong technical understanding of Automation, Electrification and Drives & Motors systems.
Certified Project Manager PM@Innomotics, PM@Siemens or IPMA S as advantage
PMI (PMP) Certification preferred, ability to obtain within 1 year of employment.
Experience with complex projects varying in size required.
Detail oriented and excellent organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously (25+ projects of low to medium complexity).
SAP experience is desired.
Strong technical understanding of Automation, Electrification and Drives & Motors systems.
Demonstrated business and financial acumen
Exceptional negotiation, communication, and presentation skills
Ability to combine strategic thinking with detailed execution
Strong team collaboration and leadership mindset
IT Knowledge: computer literate with a good knowledge of Autocad, Primavera and Microsoft Office tools particularly Excel, Word and Microsoft Project.
Willingness to travel nationally and internationally
Fluent English communication skills
What’s IN It For You (Our Benefits)
A competitive salary package, including performance-based bonuses and benefits.
Opportunities for professional development and career progression within a leading global company.
A collaborative and dynamic team environment focused on innovation and excellence.
